en: A large area of water surrounded by land.
ex: We had a picnic by the lake.
我們在湖邊野餐。

en: A device that produces light, usually using electricity.
ex: She read a book under the lamp.
她在檯燈下看書。

en: The solid part of the Earth's surface; or a country; or to arrive on the ground after traveling.
ex: The plane will land in ten minutes.
飛機將在十分鐘後降落。

en: A system of words used by people in a country or area to communicate.
ex: She can speak three languages.
她會說三種語言。

en: Bigger than average in size, amount or number.
ex: They live in a large house with a big garden.
他們住在一棟有大花園的大房子裡。

en: Coming after all others; or most recent; or to continue for a period of time.
ex: This is the last chance to buy tickets.
這是購票的最後機會。

en: After the usual or expected time; or near the end of a period.
ex: I was late for school because I missed the bus.
我因為錯過公車，上學遲到了。

en: At a time after now or after another event.
ex: I will call you later this evening.
我今晚稍後會打電話給你。

en: To make sounds with your voice because you think something is funny; or the sound of laughing.
ex: The children laughed at the clown.
孩子們被小丑逗得哈哈大笑。

en: A person whose job is to give legal advice and speak for people in court.
ex: The lawyer explained the contract to us.
律師向我們解釋了這份合約。

en: Not wanting to work or make any effort.
ex: He is too lazy to clean his room.
他懶得打掃他的房間。

en: To go in front and show the way; or to be in charge; or a soft gray metal.
ex: The guide led us through the forest.
嚮導帶領我們穿過森林。

en: A person who is in charge of a group, country or organization.
ex: She is a born leader and everyone follows her.
她是個天生的領袖，大家都追隨她。

en: To get knowledge or skill by studying or experience; or to find out about something.
ex: I am learning to play the piano.
我正在學彈鋼琴。

en: The smallest amount or degree; or less than anything else.
ex: You should read at least one book a month.
你每個月至少應該讀一本書。

en: To go away from a place; or to let something stay where it is; or time away from work.
ex: The train leaves at eight o'clock.
火車八點開。

en: On or toward the side of your body that is opposite to your right; or remaining.
ex: Turn left at the next corner.
下個街角左轉。

en: One of the long parts of your body that you use for walking; or one of the supports of a chair or table.
ex: He broke his leg while skiing.
他滑雪時摔斷了腿。

en: A yellow citrus fruit with a sour taste; or a tree that produces it.
ex: She added a slice of lemon to her tea.
她在茶裡加了一片檸檬。

en: A smaller amount of something; or not as much as.
ex: I am eating less sugar these days.
我最近吃的糖比較少。

en: A period of time when students are taught something; or something you learn from an experience.
ex: We have an English lesson at ten o'clock.
我們十點有一堂英語課。

en: To allow someone to do something; or to make something happen.
ex: Please let me help you with the bags.
請讓我幫你提這些袋子。

en: A written message sent in an envelope; or one of the symbols such as A, B and C used in writing.
ex: I wrote a letter to my pen friend.
我寫了一封信給我的筆友。

en: The height or amount of something compared with another; or flat and smooth.
ex: The water level of the river rose after the storm.
暴風雨後，河水水位上升了。

en: A place where books, magazines and other materials are kept for people to read or borrow.
ex: I borrow books from the library every week.
我每個星期都從圖書館借書。

en: To say something that is not true; or to be in a flat position; or a statement that is false.
ex: He lay on the sofa and watched TV.
他躺在沙發上看電視。

en: The period between birth and death; or the state of being alive; or the way you live.
ex: Life is full of surprises.
生活充滿驚喜。

en: Brightness from the sun or lamps that lets us see; or not heavy in weight; or to start a fire.
ex: Please turn on the light; it is too dark here.
請開燈，這裡太暗了。

en: To find someone or something pleasant; or similar to someone or something else.
ex: I like to listen to music in my free time.
我空閒時喜歡聽音樂。

en: A long, thin mark; or a row of people or things waiting; or a telephone connection.
ex: The students stood in a line at the door.
學生們在門口排成一列。

en: A large wild cat with a golden-brown coat, living in Africa and India; the male has a mane.
ex: The lion is called the king of animals.
獅子被稱為萬獸之王。

en: One of the two soft edges of your mouth.
ex: She put some lipstick on her lips.
她在嘴唇上塗了一些口紅。

en: A series of names or items written one under another; or to write items in order.
ex: I wrote a list of things to buy.
我寫了一張要買的東西清單。

en: To pay attention to a sound or to what someone is saying.
ex: Please listen carefully to the teacher.
請仔細聽老師說話。

en: Small in size or amount; or not much of something.
ex: There is a little milk left in the bottle.
瓶子裡還剩一點牛奶。

en: To be alive; or to have your home in a place; or happening now, not recorded.
ex: I live in a small apartment near the station.
我住在車站附近的一間小公寓。

en: Unhappy because you have no friends or people to talk to; or (of a place) far from other places.
ex: The old man felt lonely after his wife died.
老人在妻子過世後感到孤單。

en: Measuring a large distance from one end to the other; lasting a lot of time; or to want something very much.
ex: It is a long way from here to the station.
從這裡到車站路很遠。

en: To turn your eyes toward something to see it; or to seem to be something; or the appearance of someone.
ex: Look at the beautiful sky!
看那美麗的天空！

en: To not be able to find something; or to fail to win; or to have less of something than before.
ex: I always lose my umbrella when it rains.
每次下雨我都會弄丟我的雨傘。
